content.text: BIBI – Breast Cancer Awareness App is an educational awareness app and not a medical diagnosis or treatment service.

rows.label: Does the app collect personal data?
rows.value: Minimal – see Section 4 for full details

rows.label: Is data sold to third parties?

paragraphs: BIBI is a free, educational mobile application designed to raise awareness about breast cancer through engaging animations and storytelling. BIBI does not provide medical diagnoses, treatment plans, or clinical advice of any kind.
This Privacy Policy explains what information BIBI collects from users of the Android Application (the "Service"), how that information is used, and the rights users hold over their data.
By downloading and using BIBI, you confirm that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy and agree to the data practices described herein.
bullets: Google Play Store Data Safety Section and User Data Policy
Google Play Health Apps Declaration requirements
Pakistan's PECA 2016 and applicable data-protection principles
GDPR (EEA users), CCPA/CPRA (California users), and UK-GDPR (UK users)
App or Service - the BIBI Android mobile application.
Personal Data - any information that can identify you directly or indirectly.
Sensitive Data - special category data such as health or medical information.

items.title: Nature of the App - Important Health & Medical Disclaimer

bullets: BIBI does not diagnose breast cancer or any medical condition.
BIBI does not recommend medication, treatment, or surgery.
BIBI content is not a substitute for consultation with qualified healthcare professionals.
paragraphs: Because BIBI is an awareness and education application, it does not collect, store, or process personal health data such as medical records, diagnoses, test results, or symptom logs.

BIBI does not collect personally identifiable information. Collected data is anonymized and aggregated. BIBI follows Data Minimization and collects only what is necessary for the app to function and improve.
